linkedin.title: Most news algorithms are designed to keep you scrolling, not to keep you informed.
linkedin.body:
It is a subtle but important difference. When an engine is built to maximize engagement, it ends up feeding you outrage or whatever is trending, regardless of whether it actually matters to your life or your work. That is why your feed often feels like a messy loop of noise.

At Headlinne, we took a different approach. Instead of tracking how long you stare at a screen, we built a recommendation engine that learns from the specific topics and nuances you actually engage with over time. It is not about keeping you trapped in the app. It is about respecting your time by filtering out the noise and highlighting the signal.

Good AI in news should be like a great editor. It should know what you care about, understand your blind spots, and present information that helps you form your own opinions rather than telling you what to think. We believe technology should work for the reader, not the other way around.
linkedin.cta: If you are tired of the noise, you can see how we are doing things differently at HEADLINNE.com.

story_card.headline: iPhone Duo screens are failing
story_card.standfirst: Early reports suggest the new device's unique folding hinge is damaging displays.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Some users report their iPhone Duo screens are breaking. Apple confirms the issue.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The device features a precision-engineered hinge. This mechanism is damaging the screens.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Two independent sources confirmed the problem. It raises questions about long-term durability.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Apple says only a small number of units are affected. We are waiting for repair updates.

story_card.caption:
Some iPhone Duo screens are already failing due to a hinge issue.

Reports from Ars Technica and The Guardian suggest that the precision-engineered hinge is causing damage to the displays. While Apple maintains that the number of affected units is small, it is a significant setback for the new hardware. We will keep an eye on how the company handles repairs.
